title: "Model summary dot map (v3 — magnitude-faithful color)"
output: html_document
date: "2026-05-01"

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(glmmTMB)
  library(emmeans)
  library(brms)
  library(coda)
})

`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
```

```{r}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CONFIG
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
MODEL_DIRS <- c(
  "Density/Models",
  "Count/Models",
  "Area/Models/Total_Area",
  "Area/Models/Per_Cell_Area",
  "Ratio/Models",
  "Proportion/Models"
)

OUT_LONG_RDS <- "model_summary_long_v3.rds"
OUT_LONG_CSV <- "model_summary_long_v3.csv"

# Output paths for this file. v3 uses "_v3" suffix to coexist with v1
# (interaction contrasts) and v2 (simple effects, evidence-encoded color)
# without overwriting either.
OUT_PLOT_PRIMARY <- "npod_dot_heatmap_primary_v3.pdf"
OUT_PLOT_SUPP    <- "npod_dot_heatmap_supplementary_v3.pdf"
OUT_PLOT_PER_BLOCK_DIR <- "per_block_panels_v3"

EVIDENCE_CAP <- 25     # cap on |signed -log10(p)| so size scale doesn't blow up
SLOPE_STEP   <- 1      # finite-difference half-step for brms slopes

# AO slope reference levels for the "DD slope @ low/high AO" simple effects.
# Both contrast and slope variables are centered (suffix _c), so ±1 is one
# centered unit on either side of the population mean.
AO_LO <- -1
AO_HI <-  1

emm_options(lmer.df = "asymptotic")
```

```{r}
discover_models <- function(dirs) {
  files <- unlist(lapply(dirs, function(d) {
    if (dir.exists(d)) list.files(d, pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
    else character(0)
  }))
  files <- files[!str_detect(basename(files), "(spline|diagnostic)")]
  tibble(path = files, model_id = tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(files)))
}

parse_metadata <- function(id) {
  contrast <- if (str_detect(id, "(?:^|_)(t1d|dd|ao)(?:_|$)")) "T1D" else "Diagnosis"

  variant <- case_when(
    str_detect(id, "_powered_model$") ~ "powered",
    str_detect(id, "_mid_model$")     ~ "mid",
    str_detect(id, "_full_model$")    ~ "full",
    str_detect(id, "_ao_model$")      ~ "ao",
    str_detect(id, "_dd_model$")      ~ "dd",
    TRUE                              ~ "primary"
  )

  outcome_family <- case_when(
    str_detect(id, "^density")                                ~ "density",
    str_detect(id, "^count_")                                  ~ "count",
    str_detect(id, "^area_") |
      str_detect(id, "_combined_(model|t1d)$")                 ~ "total_area",
    str_detect(id, "^pc_")                                     ~ "per_cell_area",
    str_detect(id, "^(ins|glu|soma|pp)_(powered|t1d|dd|ao)")   ~ "proportion",
    str_detect(id, "^ratio_")                                  ~ "ratio",
    TRUE                                                        ~ NA_character_
  )

  cell <- case_when(
    str_detect(id, "ratio")                                                      ~ "beta_alpha",
    str_detect(id, "density")                                                    ~ "all_cells",
    str_detect(id, "(islet_cells|count_islet)")                                  ~ "islet_size",
    str_detect(id, "(beta|^ins_|count_ins|pc_ins|^pc_beta)")                     ~ "beta",
    str_detect(id, "(alpha|^glu_|count_glu|pc_alpha|^pc_glu)")                   ~ "alpha",
    str_detect(id, "(delta|^soma_|count_soma|pc_delta|^pc_soma)")                ~ "delta",
    str_detect(id, "(^pp_|count_pp|pc_pp|_pp_)")                                 ~ "PP",
    TRUE                                                                          ~ NA_character_
  )

  subset <- case_when(
    str_detect(id, "1cell")    ~ "1 cell",
    str_detect(id, "2to14")    ~ "2-14 cells",
    str_detect(id, "15plus")   ~ "15+ cells",
    str_detect(id, "combined") ~ "combined",
    TRUE                       ~ NA_character_
  )

  tibble(contrast = contrast, outcome_family = outcome_family,
         cell = cell, subset = subset, variant = variant)
}

get_fixed_terms <- function(model) {
  if (inherits(model, "glmmTMB")) {
    return(all.vars(formula(model, fixed.only = TRUE)))
  }
  if (inherits(model, "brmsfit")) {
    fe <- tryCatch(brms::brmsterms(model)$dpars$mu$fe$allvars,
                   error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(fe)) {
      fml <- tryCatch(model$formula$formula, error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(fml)) return(character(0))
      return(all.vars(fml))
    }
    return(all.vars(fe))
  }
  character(0)
}
```

```{r}
# glmmTMB: signed -log10(p)
# brmsfit: signed -log10(2(1-pd))
signed_evidence <- function(estimate, pseudo_p, cap = EVIDENCE_CAP) {
  ifelse(is.na(estimate) | is.na(pseudo_p), NA_real_,
         sign(estimate) * pmin(-log10(pseudo_p + 1e-300), cap))
}
```

```{r}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# GLMMTMB EXTRACTOR — simple-effects parameterization
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Replaces interaction contrasts (e.g., "Diag x Region (Body)") with
# simple effects at each level (e.g., "T1D-ND @ Head", "T1D-ND @ Body").
# The pattern: instead of asking "is the T1D effect *different* between
# regions?", we ask "what is the T1D effect *at each region?*". A reader
# can reconstruct the interaction visually by comparing dots in the same row.

# Tidy a single emmeans pair into our schema.
emm_pair_row <- function(pair_obj, label, reverse_sign = FALSE) {
  s <- as.data.frame(summary(pair_obj))
  if (nrow(s) == 0) return(NULL)
  est <- s$estimate[1] * (if (reverse_sign) -1 else 1)
  tibble(
    label     = label,
    estimate  = est,
    std.error = s$SE[1],
    conf.low  = est - 1.96 * s$SE[1],
    conf.high = est + 1.96 * s$SE[1],
    pseudo_p  = s$p.value[1]
  )
}

emm_trend_row <- function(trend_obj, label) {
  s <- as.data.frame(summary(trend_obj))
  trend_col <- grep("\\.trend$", names(s), value = TRUE)[1]
  if (is.na(trend_col)) return(NULL)
  test_df <- tryCatch(as.data.frame(test(trend_obj)),
                      error = function(e) data.frame(p.value = NA_real_))
  tibble(
    label     = label,
    estimate  = s[[trend_col]][1],
    std.error = s$SE[1],
    conf.low  = s[[trend_col]][1] - 1.96 * s$SE[1],
    conf.high = s[[trend_col]][1] + 1.96 * s$SE[1],
    pseudo_p  = test_df$p.value[1]
  )
}

# Pull a per-row tibble out of an emmeans result for a specific value of one
# grouping factor. Used for "T1D-ND @ Head" style simple effects.
emm_pair_at <- function(em_obj, group_var, group_val, label, reverse_sign = FALSE) {
  pairs_obj <- pairs(em_obj, by = group_var)
  s <- as.data.frame(summary(pairs_obj))
  if (!group_var %in% names(s)) return(NULL)
  i <- which(s[[group_var]] == group_val)
  if (length(i) == 0) return(NULL)
  est <- s$estimate[i[1]] * (if (reverse_sign) -1 else 1)
  tibble(
    label     = label,
    estimate  = est,
    std.error = s$SE[i[1]],
    conf.low  = est - 1.96 * s$SE[i[1]],
    conf.high = est + 1.96 * s$SE[i[1]],
    pseudo_p  = s$p.value[i[1]]
  )
}

# Per-group slope from emtrends; e.g. "Age slope @ ND".
emm_trend_at <- function(model, by_formula, var, by_var, by_val, label,
                         data, at_list = NULL) {
  call_args <- list(object = model, specs = by_formula, var = var, data = data)
  if (!is.null(at_list)) call_args$at <- at_list
  et <- do.call(emtrends, call_args)
  s <- as.data.frame(summary(et))
  if (!by_var %in% names(s)) return(NULL)
  trend_col <- grep("\\.trend$", names(s), value = TRUE)[1]
  if (is.na(trend_col)) return(NULL)
  i <- which(s[[by_var]] == by_val)
  if (length(i) == 0) return(NULL)
  test_df <- tryCatch(as.data.frame(test(et)),
                      error = function(e) data.frame(p.value = rep(NA_real_, nrow(s))))
  tibble(
    label     = label,
    estimate  = s[[trend_col]][i[1]],
    std.error = s$SE[i[1]],
    conf.low  = s[[trend_col]][i[1]] - 1.96 * s$SE[i[1]],
    conf.high = s[[trend_col]][i[1]] + 1.96 * s$SE[i[1]],
    pseudo_p  = test_df$p.value[i[1]]
  )
}

extract_glmmTMB <- function(model, contrast_type) {
  fe  <- get_fixed_terms(model)
  has <- function(v) all(v %in% fe)

  mf <- tryCatch(model.frame(model),
                 error = function(e) tryCatch(model$frame,
                                              error = function(e2) NULL))

  rows <- list()
  add  <- function(lbl, df) { if (!is.null(df)) rows[[lbl]] <<- df }

  # ----- DIAGNOSIS-CONTRAST MODELS -----
  if (contrast_type == "Diagnosis") {

    # Overall T1D - ND (averaged over Region and Sex)
    if (has("Diagnosis"))
      add("T1D-ND", emm_pair_row(
        pairs(emmeans(model, ~ Diagnosis, data = mf)),
        "T1D-ND", reverse_sign = TRUE))

    # T1D - ND at each Region (simple effects, no interaction needed)
    if (has(c("Diagnosis", "Region"))) {
      em <- emmeans(model, ~ Diagnosis | Region, data = mf)
      for (reg in c("Head", "Body", "Tail")) {
        add(paste0("T1D-ND @ ", reg),
            emm_pair_at(em, "Region", reg,
                        paste0("T1D-ND @ ", reg), reverse_sign = TRUE))
      }
    }

    # T1D - ND at each Sex
    if (has(c("Diagnosis", "Sex"))) {
      em <- emmeans(model, ~ Diagnosis | Sex, data = mf)
      for (sx in c("Female", "Male")) {
        add(paste0("T1D-ND @ ", sx),
            emm_pair_at(em, "Sex", sx,
                        paste0("T1D-ND @ ", sx), reverse_sign = TRUE))
      }
    }

    # Region pairwise contrasts (averaged over Diagnosis and Sex)
    if (has("Region")) {
      pr_df <- as.data.frame(summary(pairs(emmeans(model, ~ Region, data = mf))))
      for (i in seq_len(nrow(pr_df))) {
        lbl <- as.character(pr_df$contrast[i])
        add(lbl, tibble(
          label = lbl, estimate = pr_df$estimate[i], std.error = pr_df$SE[i],
          conf.low = pr_df$estimate[i] - 1.96 * pr_df$SE[i],
          conf.high = pr_df$estimate[i] + 1.96 * pr_df$SE[i],
          pseudo_p = pr_df$p.value[i]))
      }
    }

    # Male - Female (averaged over Diagnosis)
    if (has("Sex"))
      add("Male-Female", emm_pair_row(
        pairs(emmeans(model, ~ Sex, data = mf)),
        "Male-Female", reverse_sign = TRUE))

    # Age slope at each Diagnosis (simple effects)
    if (has(c("Diagnosis", "Age_c"))) {
      for (dg in c("ND", "T1D")) {
        add(paste0("Age slope @ ", dg),
            emm_trend_at(model, ~ Diagnosis, var = "Age_c",
                         by_var = "Diagnosis", by_val = dg,
                         label = paste0("Age slope @ ", dg), data = mf))
      }
    } else if (has("Age_c")) {
      # No interaction — single overall slope, label it "Age slope" for clarity
      add("Age slope", emm_trend_row(
        emtrends(model, ~ 1, var = "Age_c", data = mf), "Age slope"))
    }

    # log_IC slope at each Diagnosis
    if (has(c("Diagnosis", "log_Islet.Cells_c"))) {
      for (dg in c("ND", "T1D")) {
        add(paste0("log_IC slope @ ", dg),
            emm_trend_at(model, ~ Diagnosis, var = "log_Islet.Cells_c",
                         by_var = "Diagnosis", by_val = dg,
                         label = paste0("log_IC slope @ ", dg), data = mf))
      }
    } else if (has("log_Islet.Cells_c")) {
      add("log_IC slope", emm_trend_row(
        emtrends(model, ~ 1, var = "log_Islet.Cells_c", data = mf), "log_IC slope"))
    }

  } else {
    # ----- T1D-ONLY MODELS -----

    # Overall DD slope
    if (has("Disease.Duration_c"))
      add("DD slope", emm_trend_row(
        emtrends(model, ~ 1, var = "Disease.Duration_c", data = mf), "DD slope"))

    # DD slope at each Region
    if (has(c("Disease.Duration_c", "Region"))) {
      for (reg in c("Head", "Body", "Tail")) {
        add(paste0("DD slope @ ", reg),
            emm_trend_at(model, ~ Region, var = "Disease.Duration_c",
                         by_var = "Region", by_val = reg,
                         label = paste0("DD slope @ ", reg), data = mf))
      }
    }

    # DD slope at each Sex
    if (has(c("Disease.Duration_c", "Sex"))) {
      for (sx in c("Female", "Male")) {
        add(paste0("DD slope @ ", sx),
            emm_trend_at(model, ~ Sex, var = "Disease.Duration_c",
                         by_var = "Sex", by_val = sx,
                         label = paste0("DD slope @ ", sx), data = mf))
      }
    }

    # DD slope at low / high AO (simple effect of DD at two AO levels)
    if (has(c("Disease.Duration_c", "age_at_onset_c"))) {
      add("DD slope @ low AO",
          emm_trend_at(model, ~ age_at_onset_c, var = "Disease.Duration_c",
                       by_var = "age_at_onset_c", by_val = AO_LO,
                       label = "DD slope @ low AO", data = mf,
                       at_list = list(age_at_onset_c = c(AO_LO, AO_HI))))
      add("DD slope @ high AO",
          emm_trend_at(model, ~ age_at_onset_c, var = "Disease.Duration_c",
                       by_var = "age_at_onset_c", by_val = AO_HI,
                       label = "DD slope @ high AO", data = mf,
                       at_list = list(age_at_onset_c = c(AO_LO, AO_HI))))
    }

    # AO slope (overall — there's no "at each Diagnosis" since these are T1D-only)
    if (has("age_at_onset_c"))
      add("AO slope", emm_trend_row(
        emtrends(model, ~ 1, var = "age_at_onset_c", data = mf), "AO slope"))

    # log_IC slope (overall)
    if (has("log_Islet.Cells_c"))
      add("log_IC slope", emm_trend_row(
        emtrends(model, ~ 1, var = "log_Islet.Cells_c", data = mf), "log_IC slope"))

    # Region pairwise contrasts
    if (has("Region")) {
      pr_df <- as.data.frame(summary(pairs(emmeans(model, ~ Region, data = mf))))
      for (i in seq_len(nrow(pr_df))) {
        lbl <- as.character(pr_df$contrast[i])
        add(lbl, tibble(
          label = lbl, estimate = pr_df$estimate[i], std.error = pr_df$SE[i],
          conf.low = pr_df$estimate[i] - 1.96 * pr_df$SE[i],
          conf.high = pr_df$estimate[i] + 1.96 * pr_df$SE[i],
          pseudo_p = pr_df$p.value[i]))
      }
    }

    # Male - Female
    if (has("Sex"))
      add("Male-Female", emm_pair_row(
        pairs(emmeans(model, ~ Sex, data = mf)),
        "Male-Female", reverse_sign = TRUE))
  }

  if (length(rows) == 0) return(NULL)
  bind_rows(rows) %>%
    mutate(pd = NA_real_,
           evidence = signed_evidence(estimate, pseudo_p))
}
```

```{r}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# BRMSFIT EXTRACTOR — simple-effects parameterization
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Posterior contrasts on the response scale via fitted() + grid averaging.
# Same idea as the glmmTMB extractor: simple effects at each level instead of
# interaction contrasts.

post_summary <- function(d, label) {
  hpd <- coda::HPDinterval(coda::as.mcmc(d), prob = 0.95)
  pd  <- max(mean(d > 0, na.rm = TRUE), mean(d < 0, na.rm = TRUE))
  tibble(
    label     = label,
    estimate  = median(d, na.rm = TRUE),
    std.error = sd(d, na.rm = TRUE),
    conf.low  = hpd[1],
    conf.high = hpd[2],
    pseudo_p  = 2 * (1 - pd),
    pd        = pd
  )
}

post_fitted <- function(model, grid) {
  fitted(model, newdata = grid, re_formula = NA, summary = FALSE)
}

cell_avg <- function(pf, mask) rowMeans(pf[, mask, drop = FALSE])

extract_brmsfit <- function(model, contrast_type) {
  fe  <- get_fixed_terms(model)
  has <- function(v) all(v %in% fe)

  rows <- list()
  add  <- function(lbl, df) { if (!is.null(df)) rows[[lbl]] <<- df }

  if (contrast_type == "Diagnosis") {
    cat_grid <- expand.grid(
      Diagnosis = c("ND", "T1D"),
      Region    = c("Head", "Body", "Tail"),
      Sex       = c("Female", "Male"),
      Age_c              = 0,
      log_Islet.Cells_c  = 0,
      stringsAsFactors   = FALSE
    )
    pf <- post_fitted(model, cat_grid)

    # T1D - ND overall (averaged over Region and Sex)
    if (has("Diagnosis")) {
      nd  <- cell_avg(pf, cat_grid$Diagnosis == "ND")
      t1d <- cell_avg(pf, cat_grid$Diagnosis == "T1D")
      add("T1D-ND", post_summary(t1d - nd, "T1D-ND"))
    }

    # T1D - ND at each Region (simple effect)
    if (has(c("Diagnosis", "Region"))) {
      for (reg in c("Head", "Body", "Tail")) {
        nd  <- cell_avg(pf, cat_grid$Diagnosis == "ND"  & cat_grid$Region == reg)
        t1d <- cell_avg(pf, cat_grid$Diagnosis == "T1D" & cat_grid$Region == reg)
        add(paste0("T1D-ND @ ", reg),
            post_summary(t1d - nd, paste0("T1D-ND @ ", reg)))
      }
    }

    # T1D - ND at each Sex
    if (has(c("Diagnosis", "Sex"))) {
      for (sx in c("Female", "Male")) {
        nd  <- cell_avg(pf, cat_grid$Diagnosis == "ND"  & cat_grid$Sex == sx)
        t1d <- cell_avg(pf, cat_grid$Diagnosis == "T1D" & cat_grid$Sex == sx)
        add(paste0("T1D-ND @ ", sx),
            post_summary(t1d - nd, paste0("T1D-ND @ ", sx)))
      }
    }

    # Region pairwise (averaged over Diagnosis and Sex)
    if (has("Region")) {
      h <- cell_avg(pf, cat_grid$Region == "Head")
      b <- cell_avg(pf, cat_grid$Region == "Body")
      t <- cell_avg(pf, cat_grid$Region == "Tail")
      add("Head - Body", post_summary(h - b, "Head - Body"))
      add("Head - Tail", post_summary(h - t, "Head - Tail"))
      add("Body - Tail", post_summary(b - t, "Body - Tail"))
    }

    # Male - Female
    if (has("Sex")) {
      f <- cell_avg(pf, cat_grid$Sex == "Female")
      m <- cell_avg(pf, cat_grid$Sex == "Male")
      add("Male-Female", post_summary(m - f, "Male-Female"))
    }

    # Age slope at each Diagnosis
    if (has("Age_c")) {
      ag <- expand.grid(
        Diagnosis = c("ND","T1D"), Region = c("Head","Body","Tail"),
        Sex = c("Female","Male"),
        Age_c = c(-SLOPE_STEP, SLOPE_STEP),
        log_Islet.Cells_c = 0, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      pf_ag <- post_fitted(model, ag)
      slope_at_diag <- function(dg) {
        hi <- cell_avg(pf_ag, ag$Diagnosis == dg & ag$Age_c ==  SLOPE_STEP)
        lo <- cell_avg(pf_ag, ag$Diagnosis == dg & ag$Age_c == -SLOPE_STEP)
        (hi - lo) / (2 * SLOPE_STEP)
      }
      if (has("Diagnosis")) {
        for (dg in c("ND", "T1D")) {
          add(paste0("Age slope @ ", dg),
              post_summary(slope_at_diag(dg), paste0("Age slope @ ", dg)))
        }
      } else {
        # No Diagnosis term in model — single overall slope
        hi <- cell_avg(pf_ag, ag$Age_c ==  SLOPE_STEP)
        lo <- cell_avg(pf_ag, ag$Age_c == -SLOPE_STEP)
        add("Age slope", post_summary((hi - lo) / (2 * SLOPE_STEP), "Age slope"))
      }
    }

    # log_IC slope at each Diagnosis
    if (has("log_Islet.Cells_c")) {
      ig <- expand.grid(
        Diagnosis = c("ND","T1D"), Region = c("Head","Body","Tail"),
        Sex = c("Female","Male"),
        Age_c = 0,
        log_Islet.Cells_c = c(-SLOPE_STEP, SLOPE_STEP),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      pf_ig <- post_fitted(model, ig)
      slope_at_diag <- function(dg) {
        hi <- cell_avg(pf_ig, ig$Diagnosis == dg & ig$log_Islet.Cells_c ==  SLOPE_STEP)
        lo <- cell_avg(pf_ig, ig$Diagnosis == dg & ig$log_Islet.Cells_c == -SLOPE_STEP)
        (hi - lo) / (2 * SLOPE_STEP)
      }
      if (has("Diagnosis")) {
        for (dg in c("ND", "T1D")) {
          add(paste0("log_IC slope @ ", dg),
              post_summary(slope_at_diag(dg), paste0("log_IC slope @ ", dg)))
        }
      } else {
        hi <- cell_avg(pf_ig, ig$log_Islet.Cells_c ==  SLOPE_STEP)
        lo <- cell_avg(pf_ig, ig$log_Islet.Cells_c == -SLOPE_STEP)
        add("log_IC slope", post_summary((hi - lo) / (2 * SLOPE_STEP), "log_IC slope"))
      }
    }

  } else {
    # ----- T1D-ONLY MODELS -----
    cat_grid <- expand.grid(
      Region = c("Head","Body","Tail"),
      Sex    = c("Female","Male"),
      Disease.Duration_c = 0,
      age_at_onset_c     = 0,
      log_Islet.Cells_c  = 0,
      stringsAsFactors   = FALSE
    )

    # DD slope helper for grids that vary DD around 0
    dd_slope <- function(grid_with_dd, mask) {
      pf <- post_fitted(model, grid_with_dd)
      hi <- cell_avg(pf, mask & grid_with_dd$Disease.Duration_c ==  SLOPE_STEP)
      lo <- cell_avg(pf, mask & grid_with_dd$Disease.Duration_c == -SLOPE_STEP)
      (hi - lo) / (2 * SLOPE_STEP)
    }

    # Overall DD slope (averaged over Region and Sex)
    if (has("Disease.Duration_c")) {
      g <- expand.grid(
        Region = c("Head","Body","Tail"), Sex = c("Female","Male"),
        Disease.Duration_c = c(-SLOPE_STEP, SLOPE_STEP),
        age_at_onset_c = 0, log_Islet.Cells_c = 0, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      add("DD slope", post_summary(dd_slope(g, rep(TRUE, nrow(g))), "DD slope"))
    }

    # DD slope at each Region
    if (has(c("Disease.Duration_c", "Region"))) {
      g <- expand.grid(
        Region = c("Head","Body","Tail"), Sex = c("Female","Male"),
        Disease.Duration_c = c(-SLOPE_STEP, SLOPE_STEP),
        age_at_onset_c = 0, log_Islet.Cells_c = 0, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      pf <- post_fitted(model, g)
      for (reg in c("Head", "Body", "Tail")) {
        hi <- cell_avg(pf, g$Region == reg & g$Disease.Duration_c ==  SLOPE_STEP)
        lo <- cell_avg(pf, g$Region == reg & g$Disease.Duration_c == -SLOPE_STEP)
        add(paste0("DD slope @ ", reg),
            post_summary((hi - lo) / (2 * SLOPE_STEP),
                         paste0("DD slope @ ", reg)))
      }
    }

    # DD slope at each Sex
    if (has(c("Disease.Duration_c", "Sex"))) {
      g <- expand.grid(
        Region = c("Head","Body","Tail"), Sex = c("Female","Male"),
        Disease.Duration_c = c(-SLOPE_STEP, SLOPE_STEP),
        age_at_onset_c = 0, log_Islet.Cells_c = 0, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      pf <- post_fitted(model, g)
      for (sx in c("Female", "Male")) {
        hi <- cell_avg(pf, g$Sex == sx & g$Disease.Duration_c ==  SLOPE_STEP)
        lo <- cell_avg(pf, g$Sex == sx & g$Disease.Duration_c == -SLOPE_STEP)
        add(paste0("DD slope @ ", sx),
            post_summary((hi - lo) / (2 * SLOPE_STEP),
                         paste0("DD slope @ ", sx)))
      }
    }

    # DD slope at low / high AO
    if (has(c("Disease.Duration_c", "age_at_onset_c"))) {
      g <- expand.grid(
        Region = c("Head","Body","Tail"), Sex = c("Female","Male"),
        Disease.Duration_c = c(-SLOPE_STEP, SLOPE_STEP),
        age_at_onset_c = c(AO_LO, AO_HI),
        log_Islet.Cells_c = 0, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      pf <- post_fitted(model, g)
      for (ao_val in c(AO_LO, AO_HI)) {
        hi <- cell_avg(pf, g$age_at_onset_c == ao_val & g$Disease.Duration_c ==  SLOPE_STEP)
        lo <- cell_avg(pf, g$age_at_onset_c == ao_val & g$Disease.Duration_c == -SLOPE_STEP)
        ao_label <- if (ao_val == AO_LO) "low AO" else "high AO"
        add(paste0("DD slope @ ", ao_label),
            post_summary((hi - lo) / (2 * SLOPE_STEP),
                         paste0("DD slope @ ", ao_label)))
      }
    }

    # AO slope (overall)
    if (has("age_at_onset_c")) {
      g <- expand.grid(
        Region = c("Head","Body","Tail"), Sex = c("Female","Male"),
        Disease.Duration_c = 0,
        age_at_onset_c = c(-SLOPE_STEP, SLOPE_STEP),
        log_Islet.Cells_c = 0, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      pf <- post_fitted(model, g)
      hi <- cell_avg(pf, g$age_at_onset_c ==  SLOPE_STEP)
      lo <- cell_avg(pf, g$age_at_onset_c == -SLOPE_STEP)
      add("AO slope", post_summary((hi - lo) / (2 * SLOPE_STEP), "AO slope"))
    }

    # log_IC slope (overall)
    if (has("log_Islet.Cells_c")) {
      g <- expand.grid(
        Region = c("Head","Body","Tail"), Sex = c("Female","Male"),
        Disease.Duration_c = 0, age_at_onset_c = 0,
        log_Islet.Cells_c = c(-SLOPE_STEP, SLOPE_STEP),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      pf <- post_fitted(model, g)
      hi <- cell_avg(pf, g$log_Islet.Cells_c ==  SLOPE_STEP)
      lo <- cell_avg(pf, g$log_Islet.Cells_c == -SLOPE_STEP)
      add("log_IC slope", post_summary((hi - lo) / (2 * SLOPE_STEP), "log_IC slope"))
    }

    # Region pairwise (averaged over everything else)
    if (has("Region")) {
      pf <- post_fitted(model, cat_grid)
      h <- cell_avg(pf, cat_grid$Region == "Head")
      b <- cell_avg(pf, cat_grid$Region == "Body")
      t <- cell_avg(pf, cat_grid$Region == "Tail")
      add("Head - Body", post_summary(h - b, "Head - Body"))
      add("Head - Tail", post_summary(h - t, "Head - Tail"))
      add("Body - Tail", post_summary(b - t, "Body - Tail"))
    }

    # Male - Female
    if (has("Sex")) {
      pf <- post_fitted(model, cat_grid)
      f <- cell_avg(pf, cat_grid$Sex == "Female")
      m <- cell_avg(pf, cat_grid$Sex == "Male")
      add("Male-Female", post_summary(m - f, "Male-Female"))
    }
  }

  if (length(rows) == 0) return(NULL)
  bind_rows(rows) %>%
    mutate(evidence = signed_evidence(estimate, pseudo_p))
}
```

```{r}
extract_one <- function(path, model_id, contrast_type) {
  m <- tryCatch(readRDS(path), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(m)) { warning("Could not read: ", path); return(NULL) }

  fe <- get_fixed_terms(m)
  has_diag     <- "Diagnosis" %in% fe
  has_dd_or_ao <- any(c("Disease.Duration_c", "age_at_onset_c") %in% fe)
  inferred <- if (has_diag) "Diagnosis"
              else if (has_dd_or_ao) "T1D"
              else contrast_type
  if (inferred != contrast_type) {
    cat("  ", model_id, " [auto-corrected: ", contrast_type, " -> ", inferred, "]\n", sep = "")
    contrast_type <- inferred
  } else {
    cat("  ", model_id, " (", contrast_type, ")\n", sep = "")
  }

  out <- tryCatch({
    if (inherits(m, "glmmTMB"))      extract_glmmTMB(m, contrast_type)
    else if (inherits(m, "brmsfit")) extract_brmsfit(m, contrast_type)
    else { warning("Unknown class: ", paste(class(m), collapse = ",")); NULL }
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning("Failed on ", model_id, ": ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL
  })

  rm(m); gc(verbose = FALSE)
  if (!is.null(out) && nrow(out) > 0) {
    out$model_id          <- model_id
    out$contrast_inferred <- contrast_type
  }
  out
}
```

```{r}
meta_df <- files_df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(parse_metadata(model_id)) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("Extracting marginal contrasts/slopes (simple-effects parameterization)...\n")
fixed_long <- pmap_dfr(
  list(meta_df$path, meta_df$model_id, meta_df$contrast),
  extract_one
)

results <- fixed_long %>%
  left_join(meta_df %>% select(-contrast), by = "model_id") %>%
  rename(contrast = contrast_inferred)

saveRDS(results, OUT_LONG_RDS)
write_csv(results, OUT_LONG_CSV)
cat("Wrote", OUT_LONG_RDS, "and", OUT_LONG_CSV, "\n")
```

```{r}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# OUTCOME LABELS, ROW ORDER, SEPARATOR ANCHORS — same as v1
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
build_plot_df <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    filter(!is.na(outcome_family), !is.na(label)) %>%
    mutate(
      outcome_label = case_when(
        outcome_family == "density"                      ~ "Islet density",
        outcome_family == "count" & cell == "beta"       ~ "beta-cell count",
        outcome_family == "count" & cell == "alpha"      ~ "alpha-cell count",
        outcome_family == "count" & cell == "delta"      ~ "delta-cell count",
        outcome_family == "count" & cell == "PP"         ~ "PP-cell count",
        outcome_family == "count" & cell == "islet_size" ~ "Islet cells",
        outcome_family == "total_area"                   ~ paste0(cell, "-cell total area (", subset, ")"),
        outcome_family == "per_cell_area"                ~ paste0(cell, ": per-cell area (", subset, ")"),
        outcome_family == "proportion"                   ~ paste0("% ", cell, "-cell"),
        outcome_family == "ratio"                        ~ "beta:alpha ratio",
        TRUE                                             ~ model_id
      ),
      z_like = ifelse(std.error > 0, estimate / std.error, NA_real_)
    ) %>%
    # ----- WITHIN-BLOCK NORMALIZATION FOR COLOR (v3) -----
    # Color encodes signed magnitude on the model's natural scale (log-ratio
    # for glmmTMB log-link models, probability difference for ordbetareg),
    # rescaled so that the largest |estimate| within each outcome_family
    # saturates at ±1. This makes the color scale BIOLOGICALLY MAGNITUDE-
    # FAITHFUL within block (a deeply-colored cell is large for its class)
    # and visually comparable across blocks (a deeply-colored cell in any
    # block is "the dominant effect for this kind of outcome"), without
    # falsely conflating different units (a 95% T1D loss vs a 5% PP shift).
    group_by(outcome_family) %>%
    mutate(
      block_max_abs    = max(abs(estimate), na.rm = TRUE),
      color_val        = ifelse(block_max_abs > 0,
                                estimate / block_max_abs, 0)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}

outcome_order <- c(
  "Islet density",
  "beta-cell count", "alpha-cell count", "delta-cell count", "PP-cell count", "Islet cells",
  outer(c("1 cell","2-14 cells","15+ cells","combined"),
        c("beta","alpha","delta","PP"),
        function(s, c) paste0(c, "-cell total area (", s, ")")) %>% as.vector(),
  outer(c("2-14 cells","15+ cells","combined"),
        c("beta","alpha","delta","PP"),
        function(s, c) paste0(c, ": per-cell area (", s, ")")) %>% as.vector(),
  "% beta-cell", "% alpha-cell", "% delta-cell", "% PP-cell",
  "beta:alpha ratio"
)

sep_y_after <- function(label) {
  length(outcome_order) - match(label, outcome_order) + 0.5
}

separators_major_y <- c(
  sep_y_after("Islet cells"),
  sep_y_after("PP-cell total area (combined)"),
  sep_y_after("PP: per-cell area (combined)"),
  sep_y_after("% PP-cell")
)

separators_minor_y <- c(
  sep_y_after("beta-cell total area (combined)"),
  sep_y_after("alpha-cell total area (combined)"),
  sep_y_after("delta-cell total area (combined)"),
  sep_y_after("beta: per-cell area (combined)"),
  sep_y_after("alpha: per-cell area (combined)"),
  sep_y_after("delta: per-cell area (combined)")
)

stopifnot(!any(is.na(separators_major_y)))
stopifnot(!any(is.na(separators_minor_y)))
```

```{r}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# COLUMN ORDER — simple-effects parameterization (replaces v1's interactions)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Diagnosis panel (13 columns):
#   Block 1: T1D - ND overall + per-region + per-sex simple effects
#   Block 2: Region pairwise + Male-Female
#   Block 3: Age slope at each Diagnosis
#   Block 4: log_IC slope at each Diagnosis
#
# T1D panel (14 columns):
#   Block 1: DD slope overall + per-region + per-sex + per-AO simple effects
#   Block 2: AO slope, log_IC slope (overall — these don't have Diagnosis as a moderator)
#   Block 3: Region pairwise + Male-Female

term_order_diag <- c(
  # Block 1: T1D effect, in detail
  "T1D-ND",
  "T1D-ND @ Head", "T1D-ND @ Body", "T1D-ND @ Tail",
  "T1D-ND @ Female", "T1D-ND @ Male",
  # Block 2: anatomy / demographics
  "Head - Body", "Head - Tail", "Body - Tail",
  "Male-Female",
  # Block 3: Age slope by diagnosis
  "Age slope", "Age slope @ ND", "Age slope @ T1D",
  # Block 4: log_IC slope by diagnosis
  "log_IC slope", "log_IC slope @ ND", "log_IC slope @ T1D"
)

term_order_t1d <- c(
  # Block 1: DD slope, in detail
  "DD slope",
  "DD slope @ Head", "DD slope @ Body", "DD slope @ Tail",
  "DD slope @ Female", "DD slope @ Male",
  "DD slope @ low AO", "DD slope @ high AO",
  # Block 2: other slopes (overall only — no Diagnosis to stratify by)
  "AO slope", "log_IC slope",
  # Block 3: anatomy / demographics
  "Head - Body", "Head - Tail", "Body - Tail",
  "Male-Female"
)

all_term_order <- unique(c(term_order_diag, term_order_t1d))

# Within-panel sub-block separators (faint vertical lines).
# Positions are after the named term; on a discrete x-axis, the separator
# sits at index + 0.5 from the term's position.
diag_block_breaks <- c(
  match("T1D-ND @ Male",     term_order_diag) + 0.5,  # block 1 | block 2
  match("Male-Female",       term_order_diag) + 0.5,  # block 2 | block 3
  match("Age slope @ T1D",   term_order_diag) + 0.5   # block 3 | block 4
)
t1d_block_breaks <- c(
  match("DD slope @ high AO", term_order_t1d) + 0.5,  # block 1 | block 2
  match("log_IC slope",       term_order_t1d) + 0.5   # block 2 | block 3
)

clip <- function(x, lim) pmax(pmin(x, lim), -lim)

# Tighter cap and wider size range — smaller dots get genuinely small,
# evidence above p=0.001 saturates (which is fine: beyond that, color carries
# the differentiation, and you mostly care about direction not "how strong").
EVIDENCE_VIS_CAP <- 3
SIZE_RANGE       <- c(0.2, 5.5)
```

```{r}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot builder
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
make_dot_heatmap <- function(df, title, subtitle, extra_facet = NULL,
                             show_block_breaks = TRUE) {
  d_built <- build_plot_df(df)

  unknown <- setdiff(unique(d_built$label), all_term_order)
  if (length(unknown) > 0) {
    warning("Dropping unmapped contrast labels (add to term_order if you want them): ",
            paste(unknown, collapse = ", "))
    d_built <- d_built %>% filter(label %in% all_term_order)
  }

  greek <- function(x) {
    x %>%
      stringr::str_replace_all("\\bbeta\\b",  "\u03b2") %>%
      stringr::str_replace_all("\\balpha\\b", "\u03b1") %>%
      stringr::str_replace_all("\\bdelta\\b", "\u03b4")
  }

  d <- d_built %>%
    mutate(
      outcome_label = factor(greek(outcome_label),
                             levels = greek(rev(outcome_order))),
      label         = factor(label, levels = all_term_order),
      contrast      = factor(contrast, levels = c("Diagnosis", "T1D"))
    )

  facet_spec <- if (is.null(extra_facet)) {
    facet_grid(. ~ contrast, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x")
  } else {
    facet_grid(reformulate("contrast", extra_facet),
               scales = "free_x", space = "free_x")
  }

  # Vertical sub-block separators inside each panel (in addition to the thick
  # black panel.border between panels). Per-facet using `data` arg.
  vlines_df <- bind_rows(
    if (show_block_breaks)
      data.frame(contrast = "Diagnosis", xint = diag_block_breaks)
    else data.frame(contrast = character(0), xint = numeric(0)),
    if (show_block_breaks)
      data.frame(contrast = "T1D", xint = t1d_block_breaks)
    else data.frame(contrast = character(0), xint = numeric(0))
  ) %>% mutate(contrast = factor(contrast, levels = c("Diagnosis", "T1D")))

  ggplot(d, aes(x = label, y = outcome_label)) +
    # Horizontal separators (drawn under the dots)
    geom_hline(data = data.frame(yint = separators_minor_y),
               aes(yintercept = yint), inherit.aes = FALSE,
               color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_hline(data = data.frame(yint = separators_major_y),
               aes(yintercept = yint), inherit.aes = FALSE,
               color = "grey55", linewidth = 0.7) +
    # Vertical sub-block separators (per facet)
    {if (show_block_breaks && nrow(vlines_df) > 0)
      geom_vline(data = vlines_df, aes(xintercept = xint),
                 inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.35)
     else NULL} +
    geom_point(aes(color = color_val,
                   size  = pmin(abs(evidence), EVIDENCE_VIS_CAP)),
               shape = 16, stroke = 0, na.rm = TRUE) +
    facet_spec +
    scale_color_gradient2(
      low = "#0C447C", mid = "#F5F5F2", high = "#791F1F",
      midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1),
      breaks = c(-1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1),
      labels = c("-100%", "-50%", "0", "50%", "100%"),
      name = "effect size\n(% of largest\nin outcome class)"
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(
      range  = SIZE_RANGE,
      limits = c(0, EVIDENCE_VIS_CAP),
      breaks = c(-log10(0.05), -log10(0.01), -log10(0.001)),
      labels = c("0.05", "0.01", "0.001"),
      name   = "p / 2(1-pd)"
    ) +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = subtitle, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
      axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 8.5),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.5),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border     = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.9),
      panel.spacing.x  = unit(0.05, "lines"),
      strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(color = "grey30", size = 8.5),
      legend.position  = "right"
    )
}
```

```{r primary-plot}
  subtitle = paste(
    "Color = signed effect size, normalized within outcome class to the largest |estimate| in that class.",
    "Within a block (e.g., counts), the most-saturated cells are the dominant effects for that outcome type.",
    "Across blocks, color is comparable in *relative* terms but not absolute units (counts: log-ratio; HTC: probability difference).",
    "Size = signed evidence (-log10 p for glmmTMB, -log10[2(1-pd)] for ordbetareg), capped at p=0.001.",
    sep = "\n")
)

ggsave(OUT_PLOT_PRIMARY, p_primary, width = 14, height = 11, device = cairo_pdf)
```

```{r per-block-panels}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PER-BLOCK PANELS — six supplementary figures, one per outcome class
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Same column set as the main figure (shared axis), filtered to one
# outcome_family at a time. Each panel keeps its own block separators / style
# so you can read it standalone, but the column set is the union of all the
# main panel's columns for visual alignment if shown side by side.
#
# The Density and Ratio panels will be visually sparse (1 row each); that's
# expected and intentional for the shared-axis layout.

dir.create(OUT_PLOT_PER_BLOCK_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

per_block_specs <- list(
  list(name = "density",       title = "Density",          height = 3.0),
  list(name = "count",         title = "Counts",           height = 4.5),
  list(name = "total_area",    title = "Total area",       height = 7.5),
  list(name = "per_cell_area", title = "Per-cell area",    height = 6.5),
  list(name = "proportion",    title = "Proportions",      height = 4.0),
  list(name = "ratio",         title = "Beta:alpha ratio", height = 3.0)
)

for (spec in per_block_specs) {
  block_df <- results_primary %>% filter(outcome_family == spec$name)
  if (nrow(block_df) == 0) {
    cat("Skipping", spec$name, "(no rows)\n"); next
  }
  p <- make_dot_heatmap(
    block_df,
    title    = paste("nPOD models —", spec$title),
    subtitle = "Marginal contrasts and slopes (color: % of largest effect in this class)"
  )
  out_path <- file.path(OUT_PLOT_PER_BLOCK_DIR,
                        paste0("npod_dot_heatmap_", spec$name, "_v3.pdf"))
  ggsave(out_path, p, width = 14, height = spec$height, device = cairo_pdf)
  cat("Wrote", out_path, "\n")
}
```
